svg.title: Archive a team, and delete one that was a mistake — SoftTrack web design mockup (#322)
svg.desc: Nothing removes a team. Archiving makes one read-only and takes it out of the switcher, pickers and search while its tickets, comments and history stay; unarchiving puts it back. Deleting is only for a team with no tickets, and an archived team’s key is never reused.
